counts.title: Wire fraud
counts.notes: Forfeiture is alleged as to Count 1 only (¶21–22).

amounts.notes: ¶16 Liberty Plus received more than $1.2 million. Charging allegation. Not proven_loss. Not to be summed with ¶8 program-wide figures.
¶8: Program paid out more than $21 million in 2021. USAO background in this information. Not Anwar-specific.
¶8 first six months of 2025. Not Anwar-specific.

docket_plea_lead: CL docket: change of plea 2025-10-23 and waiver of indictment ECF 8. Plea is a docket fact; counts of conviction still need judgment/plea agreement before ADJUDICATED.
related: Information alleges Anwar diverted proceeds to brother Asad Adow (25-cr-354). Not itself a charging document against Asad.

quotes.owner: The defendant ANWAR AHMED ADOW was the owner and principal of Liberty Plus LLC, a company based out of a business suite in Roseville, Minnesota. ADOW registered Liberty Plus LLC with the State of Minnesota in or about November 2022. (¶10)
quotes.received: Ultimately, based on inflated and fraudulent claims, Liberty Plus received more than $1.2 million in Medicaid funds for services purportedly provided to approximately 200 beneficiaries. (¶16)
quotes.asad: ADOW diverted much of those taxpayer dollars to his conspirators, including his employees at Liberty and his brother, Asad Adow. (¶17)
quotes.program_2024: That figure ballooned in the following years: $42 million in 2022, $74 million in 2023, $104 million in 2024. (¶8)

editorial: ¶7 'susceptible to fraud' is program-design language in a charging document, not actor-specific evidence of official misconduct (D) or official criminal participation (E). ¶1 'millions of dollars' is scheme-purpose rhetoric; the specific Liberty Plus figure is >$1.2 million received (¶16). SOS file 1349782500024 (Liberty Plus LLC, 2022-11-17) is consistent with ¶10.
